# Southline Outdoor Co.: Uniform and Presentation Policy

**Version:** 1.0
**Effective:** 1 July 2026
**Owner:** Retail Operations
**Applies to:** All store team members

---

## 1. Purpose

This policy sets out what team members wear on shift, so customers can
always recognise who works in the store.

## 2. Uniform

Team members wear the green Southline polo shirt and dark trousers or
shorts on every shift. Two polo shirts are provided free on your first day;
extra shirts cost $15 each through your Store Manager. Name badges must be
worn at all times on the shop floor.

## 3. Footwear

- Closed-toe shoes must be worn at all times.
- Shoes must be black or brown.
- Sandals, thongs and slides are not allowed, including in the stockroom.

## 4. Exceptions

Store Managers can approve changes for medical or religious reasons. Ask
your Store Manager in writing before your next shift.

## 5. Questions

Ask your Store Manager about anything this policy doesn't cover.
